zh.title: 第 1 章 数据
zh.text: 从 DeepSeek 合成的新生数据出发，把「数据是什么」拆成四件可操作的事：怎么装载、怎么定义、怎么分类、怎么变换。 说清 DIKW 金字塔的四级，并指出可视化主要停在「信息」这一级，很难跨到「智慧」 用 Stevens 的 4 种测量尺度给一列字段分类，并识别出区间尺度没有真零点 按 Mackinlay 的通道排名把属性映射到合适的视觉通道，并说出错配会丢什么信息 用 d3.csv 的 row 回调，一行代码完成「加载 + 字段映射 + 类型转换」 用 enter / update / exit 三态解释数据变化时 DOM 发生了什么，并说明 key 函数为什么是过渡动画的前提

en.title: Chapter 1 Data
en.text: Starting from a DeepSeek-synthesized freshman dataset, breaking 'what is data' into four actionable tasks: loading, defining, classifying and transforming. Explain the four levels of the DIKW pyramid and why visualization mostly stops at Information Classify fields with Stevens' four measurement scales and spot that interval scales have no true zero Map attributes onto visual channels using Mackinlay's ranking, and say what information a mismatch loses Use d3.csv's row callback to do loading, field mapping and type conversion in one line Explain the enter / update / exit model and why a key function is a prerequisite for smooth transitions

DIKW 金字塔
zh.text: 把「数据 → 信息 → 知识 → 智慧」四级串起来的层次模型。数据是原始观察，信息是组织过的数据，知识是从信息里提炼出的规律，智慧是据知识做判断。 可视化的能力边界就在这里：它主要把数据升到信息，少数场景能到知识，跨不到智慧。分不清这一层，就很容易承诺可视化做不到的事。

en.title: DIKW pyramid
en.text: A four-level hierarchy: data → information → knowledge → wisdom. Data are raw observations, information is data that has been organised, knowledge is the regularities distilled from information, and wisdom is judgement built on that knowledge. zh.title: 名义尺度
zh.text: Stevens 四种测量尺度里最弱的一种：只允许判断相等或不等，没有任何顺序。姓名、性别都属于这一类。 名义数据只能用色相、形状这类定性通道编码 —— 给性别做平均值是没有意义的。

en.title: Nominal scale
en.text: The weakest of Stevens' four measurement scales: values can only be tested for equality or difference, with no order at all. Names and gender fall into this class. Nominal data can only be encoded on qualitative channels such as hue and shape — averaging gender is meaningless, and so is a line chart that implies an order between categories.

zh.title: 序数尺度
zh.text: 值之间有顺序，但相邻两级的差不一定相等。学历（本科 / 硕士 / 博士）是典型例子。 差不一定相等，所以序数数据很适合用亮度、饱和度这类顺序通道，而不适合用位置。

en.title: Ordinal scale
en.text: Values have an order, but the gaps between adjacent levels need not be equal. Education level (bachelor / master / doctorate) is the classic example. Because the gaps are unequal, ordinal data suits ordered channels such as lightness and saturation, and is a poor fit for position — a position axis invites readers to measure distances that mean nothing.

zh.title: 区间尺度与比率尺度
zh.text: 区间尺度支持加减（摄氏温度），比率尺度还支持乘除（年龄、价格）。唯一的区别是有没有「真零点」。 0°C 不等于没有温度，所以不能说 20°C 是 10°C 的两倍；0 元才等于没有钱。这条决定了什么时候可以算比值。

en.title: Interval vs. ratio scale
en.text: Interval scales support addition and subtraction (Celsius temperature); ratio scales additionally support multiplication and division (age, price). The only difference is whether there is a true zero. 0 °C does not mean 'no temperature', so 20 °C is not twice as warm as 10 °C; 0 yuan does mean 'no money'. This decides when a ratio is meaningful — and when a bar chart lies by starting from a fake zero.

zh.title: 视觉通道
zh.text: 承载数据变化的视觉属性，位置、长度、角度、面积、亮度、饱和度、色相、形状、纹理等。 Mackinlay 把通道按表达能力排了序：位置最能表达定量，色相最能表达定性。属性与通道配错，信息就会丢。

en.title: Visual channel
en.text: A visual property that can carry variation in data: position, length, angle, area, brightness, saturation, hue, shape, texture. Mackinlay ranked channels by how much they can express: position is the strongest for quantitative values, hue the strongest for categories. Pair an attribute with the wrong channel and information is lost — a pie chart is exactly that mistake.

zh.title: Data-Join 三态
zh.text: 把数据数组绑定到 DOM 元素时出现的三种情况：元素不够是 enter，正好是 update，多了是 exit。 这是 D3 的核心心智模型。理解了它，D3 就从「一堆 API」变成「一条数据到画面的映射」。

en.title: Data-join, three states
en.text: Binding an array of data to DOM elements produces three cases: too few elements is enter, an exact match is update, surplus elements is exit. This is the core mental model of D3. Once you have it, D3 stops being a pile of APIs and becomes one mapping from data to pixels; without it, every selection method feels arbitrary.

zh.title: key 函数
zh.text: 在绑定数据时告诉 D3「哪个数据对应哪个元素」的函数，通常写成 d => d.id。 没有 key，D3 按数组下标认身份：数据一重排，所有元素都算「变过」，过渡动画就乱了。有 key，元素才知道自己是谁。

en.title: Key function
en.text: A function that tells D3 which data item belongs to which element when binding, usually written d => d.id. Without a key, D3 identifies elements by array index: reorder the data and every element counts as changed, so transitions scramble. With a key, each element knows who it is and animates from its own previous state.

zh.title: Card 数据流模型
zh.text: 把可视化拆成四步：原数据 → 数据表 → 视觉结构 → 视图。1999 年由 Stuart Card 提出。 它是整门课的骨架。有了这套坐标系，遇到任何一张陌生的图，你都能问「它在哪一步做了什么处理」。

en.title: Card's pipeline model
en.text: Stuart Card's 1999 model splits visualization into four stages: raw data → data tables → visual structures → views. It is the skeleton of this whole course. With that frame you can meet any unfamiliar chart and ask what it did at each stage — what was filtered, what was encoded, what was drawn.

zh.title: d3.rollup
zh.text: 按给定键分组，并对每组算出一个聚合值，返回 Map。和 d3.group 的区别是它只留聚合结果。 把平表变成层次结构最实用的一步。树形图、分组柱状图的上游数据几乎都是它生成的。

en.title: d3.rollup
en.text: Group by the given key and reduce each group to a single value, returning a Map. Unlike d3.group, it keeps only the aggregate. It is the most practical single step from a flat table to a hierarchy: treemaps, grouped bars and stacked areas almost always start from a d3.rollup call.

zh.title: Reingold-Tilford 布局
zh.text: 一种经典树状图布局算法，让同层节点均匀铺开，同时父节点尽量居中于其子节点之上。 手写树布局很容易左右不平衡、线条交叉。这个算法把「看起来舒服」这件事变成了可计算的规则。

en.title: Reingold–Tilford layout
en.text: A classic tree layout that spreads siblings evenly across the available width while keeping each parent centred over its children. Hand-rolled tree layouts drift out of balance and cross their own edges. This algorithm turns 'looks tidy' into a computable rule, which is why d3.tree() still implements it.

zh.title: 事件委托
zh.text: 把监听器绑在父元素上，靠事件冒泡统一处理所有子元素的事件。 元素数量成千上万时，给每个元素单独绑监听器的开销会线性上涨。委托只有一个监听器，而且动态增删的子元素也能自动接管。

en.title: Event delegation
en.text: Attach one listener to a parent element and let events bubble up from its children, handling them all in one place. With thousands of elements, per-element listeners grow linearly and leak as elements come and go. One delegated listener stays flat — and children added later are handled automatically.

zh.title: 颜色空间
zh.text: 描述颜色的坐标系。RGB 面向屏幕，HSL 面向直觉，Lab / HCL 面向感知。 做数据映射必须用感知均匀的空间：在 RGB 里等距离的两个颜色，人眼看着并不等距，映射出来的图会骗人。

en.title: Color space
en.text: A coordinate system for describing colour: RGB is built for screens, HSL for intuition, Lab and HCL for perception. Mapping data to colour demands a perceptually uniform space. Two colours the same distance apart in RGB are not the same distance apart to the eye, so a colormap built in RGB will lie about magnitude.

zh.title: colormap 三类
zh.text: 顺序型（数值单调变化）、发散型（有一个有意义的中间值）、定性型（类别之间无顺序）。 选错类型的代价很大：给没有中心的数据用发散型，读者会读出一个不存在的中心；给类别数据用顺序型，读者会以为类别能比大小。

en.title: Three colormap types
en.text: Sequential (a value rises monotonically), diverging (a meaningful midpoint) and qualitative (categories with no order). Getting the type wrong is expensive: a diverging map on data without a centre invents one, and a sequential map on categories makes readers think the categories can be ranked.

zh.title: 色觉缺陷（CVD）
zh.text: 红绿色盲、蓝黄色盲等色觉差异。男性中红绿色盲比例约为 8%。 只靠色相区分数据，意味着约每十二个男性读者里就有一个读不了你的图。这是把「可读性」变成硬指标的少数几处之一。

en.title: Colour-vision deficiency
en.text: Colour-vision deficiencies such as protanopia and deuteranopia (red–green) or tritanopia (blue–yellow). Around 8% of men are red–green colour-blind. Encoding data by hue alone means roughly one in twelve male readers cannot read your chart. This is one of the few places where accessibility becomes a hard, checkable requirement.

zh.title: Wong 色板
zh.text: 发表在 Nature Methods (2011) 的一组定性色板，经过色觉缺陷友好性与等亮度检验。 本网站自身的配色也取自这套色板 —— 课程讲的配色原则，在课程网站自己身上先用一遍。

en.title: Wong palette
en.text: A qualitative palette published in Nature Methods (2011), tested both for colour-vision deficiency and for even lightness. This site's own palette comes from it: the principles the course teaches are applied to the course site itself, so the lessons and the medium agree.

zh.title: 鲜艳 + 低饱和
zh.text: 一类配色策略：保色相上的区分度（鲜艳），同时压低饱和度（不刺眼），并把颜色数量控制在 7 个以内。 高饱和多色最大的问题不是丑，是「吵」—— 每一块颜色都在抢注意力，读者反而找不到重点。

en.title: Vivid but low saturation
en.text: A palette strategy that keeps hue separation (vivid) while pushing saturation down (easy on the eye), with the number of colours capped around seven. The problem with many saturated colours is not ugliness but noise: every patch competes for attention, so the reader finds no focus. Lower saturation lets one accent do the pointing.

zh.title: 三层坐标变换
zh.text: 数据空间（语义）→ 坐标系空间（几何）→ 屏幕空间（像素）。每一层只负责一件事。 初学者常把这三种变换揉在一起写，于是改一处就崩一片。分层之后，比例尺该做什么、什么不该做，就清楚了。

en.title: Three-layer coordinate transform
en.text: Data space (meaning) → coordinate space (geometry) → screen space (pixels). Each layer does exactly one job. Beginners fold the three transforms into one expression, so a change in one breaks the rest. Kept apart, it becomes obvious what a scale should do — and what it should never do.

zh.title: Cleveland 45° 黄金角
zh.text: 人眼对斜率的估计在 45° 附近最准确（也称 banking to 45°）。 它把「图表该多宽多高」从审美问题变成了感知问题：想让人准确比较趋势，就把主要趋势线摆到 45° 附近。

en.title: Cleveland's 45° sweet spot
en.text: The eye estimates slopes most accurately near 45°, a result known as banking to 45°. It turns aspect ratio from a question of taste into a question of perception: if readers must compare trends, put the dominant trend near 45° instead of arguing about how tall the chart should be.

zh.title: Marching Squares
zh.text: 在规则网格上逐格判断四角与阈值的关系，生成等值线段，再拼接成完整等值线的算法。 它是等值线图和热力图平滑化的底层。难点不在循环，而在「四角两两高于阈值」时的歧义格子 —— 连线方式不同，结果形状会不一样。

en.title: Marching Squares
en.text: A grid algorithm that tests each cell's four corners against a threshold and stitches the resulting segments into full contour lines. It underlies contour plots and smoothed heatmaps. The difficulty is not the loop but the ambiguous cells where two corners are above the threshold and two below — different resolutions give different shapes.

zh.title: 时间的 5 个属性
zh.text: 有序、连续、周期、独立于空间、有结构（间隔有含义）。 其中「独立于空间」这一条最关键：空间数据的位置自带信息，时间必须由你决定它怎么落到平面上，所以时间可视化才有这么多非标准布局。

en.title: Five attributes of time
en.text: Ordered, continuous, cyclic, independent of space, and structured (intervals carry meaning). 'Independent of space' matters most: spatial position carries its own information, but time has no position until you choose one — which is why time visualization has so many non-standard layouts.

zh.title: van Wijk 日历热图
zh.text: 把一年按「行 = 年 / 列 = 周」摆成网格，用颜色表示每天的值。 它牺牲了精确的数值比较，换来整年的模式识别 —— 这是布局设计里典型的「用精度换结构」。

en.title: van Wijk calendar heatmap
en.text: A calendar grid with years as rows and weeks as columns, colouring each day by its value. It gives up precise value comparison in exchange for pattern recognition across a whole year — the classic 'trade precision for structure' move in layout design.

zh.title: 阿基米德螺旋
zh.text: 半径随角度线性增长的螺旋线。把时间沿它排列，同一周期的数据会落在同一条辐射方向上。 折线图会把周期切成碎片，螺旋则让周期对齐成径向的一条条 —— 周期性因此变得可以直接看出来。

en.title: Archimedean spiral
en.text: A spiral whose radius grows linearly with angle. Laying time along it makes data from the same phase of each cycle fall on the same ray. A line chart chops a cycle into fragments; a spiral aligns the cycles into radial spokes, so periodicity becomes visible at a glance.

zh.title: Storyline
zh.text: 多角色叙事可视化：每条线代表一个角色、组织或进程，线的交叉表示它们相遇或产生关系。 它是少数几个能把「叙事结构」本身画出来的方法。《侏罗纪公园》案例里，角色线的交织就是剧情的结构。

en.title: Storyline
en.text: A narrative visualization in which each line is a character, organisation or process, and crossings mark encounters or relationships. It is one of the few methods that draws narrative structure itself. In the Jurassic Park case, the interweaving of the character lines is the plot.

zh.title: 比例尺（scale）
zh.text: 把数据域映射到值域的函数。连续量用 scaleLinear，离散分类用 scaleBand，序数可用 scalePoint。 选错比例尺是最常见的新手错误：给类别数据用线性比例尺，会算出「0.5 班」这种没有意义的值。

en.title: Scale
en.text: A function mapping a data domain to a visual range. Continuous values use scaleLinear, ordered categories use scaleBand, and points on a category axis use scalePoint. Picking the wrong scale is the most common beginner error: a linear scale on categorical data produces meaningless values such as '0.5 of a class'.

zh.title: colormap 与色板的区别
zh.text: colormap 是连续的（可插值），用于数值映射；色板是离散的一组颜色，用于类别区分。 把连续的 colormap 用在类别数据上，会暗示类别之间有中间态；把离散色板用在数值上，则会让读者以为数据是分档的。

en.title: Colormap vs. palette
en.text: A colormap is continuous and interpolated, used to map values; a palette is a discrete set of colours, used to separate categories. A continuous colormap on categorical data implies states in between; a discrete palette on continuous values implies the data is binned. Neither claim is true, and both mislead.
